panel.title: NVIDIA Driver Update
panel.step_3_desc: Resolving driver packages from Arch Linux ({{version}})

panel.step_7_desc: Installing into the running system (brief rootfs unlock)
panel.done_body: Games, saves, Steam login, Decky and other disks/partitions were never touched. Reboot to load the new driver.

panel.toast_installed_body: Reboot to load the new driver.
panel.toast_already_running_body: An update is already in progress.
panel.rootfs_warning_body: Root partition: ~{{size}} (recommended minimum: 8GiB). The install may fail from lack of space. Grow rootfs-A/B with steamos-nvidia-installer if needed.
panel.show_builds_desc: Show every build number instead of just the newest per version.
